how: Go Ape runs treetop high-ropes courses at Alexandra Palace, Battersea Park and Trent Country Park (Cockfosters).
Go Ape's Alexandra Palace course includes ziplines with panoramic views over London.
Scoil Rince Ceim Oir runs an all-levels adult Irish dance class on Mondays at the Irish Cultural Centre, with a free taster available; several other London schools also teach adults.
The Southbank Centre hosts a Javanese gamelan with beginner and advanced evening classes for adults, no musical background needed (schedule from older listings).
iFLY London operates a 4.3 m vertical wind tunnel at The O2 with instructor-led introductory two-flight sessions from age 3.
Four Winds Mahjong Club runs weekly teacher-led beginner tables at the ESEA Community Centre in Hackney and Camden Chinese Community Centre; Dear Asia London runs workshops and Just Play sessions.
The London Chinese Community Centre lists beginner, Level 1 and Level 2 calligraphy classes, and ClassBento lists one-off brush and ink workshops.
FirePetal Studio in Stratford runs two-hour beginner lampwork glass bead workshops; other studios offer lampwork jewellery sessions.
The British Origami Society has a London group whose meetings welcome all members and visitors; classes and a newsletter are run via London Origami.
Croydon Disc Golf is a 21-hole course in the London Borough of Croydon listed on UDisc with tens of thousands of recorded rounds.
Beginner macrame workshops (plant hangers, wall hangings, bags) run regularly at London studios and cafes, listed on ClassBento, Obby and Eventbrite.
First Time offers introductory watchmaking workshops in London at a watchmaker's bench; full-time watchmaking training is at the British School of Watchmaking in Manchester.
The UCL Go (Weiqi, Baduk) Society runs weekly games and beginner coaching, and the West London Go Club and London City Go Club (via the British Go Association) meet in the city.
KCL Cubing Society runs weekly practice sessions, 1v1s and mini competitions and takes part in the UK Cubing League.
Kanpai London, London's first sake brewery in Peckham, brews sake locally and offers visits and tasting sessions; koji and sake-making workshops are held as one-off events.
ClassBento lists many ikebana taster workshops and a four-week beginner course across London, plus Sogetsu lessons in Camden and Ohara School England Chapter workshops.
Gohobi in Hackney Wick runs kintsugi introduction workshops where participants repair their own ceramic piece, and ClassBento lists a 90-minute class in Maida Vale.
Urban Sketchers London organises monthly weekend sketchcrawls and free sketchwalks (e.g. Chiswick Pier), and the informal Sketchbook London meetup picks a new location each week with no sign-up.

how: Beginner Chinese ink painting workshops run at London venues such as Cha-Fe (Canada Water), Liberte Concept (Bethnal Green) and via ClassBento's The Magic Brush.
Beginner batik painting workshops run at Battersea Power Station (Batik Ying), Firepit Art Gallery in Greenwich and other London venues.
venue: Batik Ying at Battersea Power Station

how: TattooBar in East London (E16) runs small-group three-day beginner tattoo courses covering machine setup, hygiene, linework and shading.
Global Game Jam holds in-person 48-hour sites in London, with Goldsmiths hosting Europe's largest site in 2026 and City, University of London and SAE Institute also hosting.
MCM London Comic Con at ExCeL is the main cosplay event, and the London Cosplay & Kawaii Community meetup group organises outings and meets.
AFL London runs an eight-club league across Premiership, Conference and Social grades from April to August, plus the Auskick programme for ages 5-12.
venue: AFL London (North London Lions, West London Wildcats)

how: Ham Polo Club in Richmond runs an Adult Academy (16+) with beginner lessons and after-work and weekend sessions on two polo grounds and an all-weather arena.
Suburban clubs including Merton Park, Wanstead and Holtwhites (Enfield) run free taster and introductory evenings and lend bowls to newcomers.
Virgin Balloon Flights launches passenger flights from sites around London such as Brentwood (Essex) and Welwyn Garden City; no launches occur from central London itself.
WSET School London on Bermondsey Street runs WSET Levels 1-4 in wine and spirits (weekday, evening and weekend), and Humble Grape also lists WSET courses.
London Whisky Club holds a monthly pay-per-tasting evening in central London and the Scotch Malt Whisky Society runs members' tastings from its Farringdon room.
The Scotch Malt Whisky Society has a London Members' Room in Farringdon with paid annual membership, and London Whisky Club is free to join.
venue: Scotch Malt Whisky Society London Members' Room

how: The nearest paragliding training is on the South Downs in Sussex (Fly Sussex and Airworks at Glynde, near Lewes), roughly 1.5 hours from central London by train; London has no suitable flying hills.

London Language Exchange meets every Tuesday evening in the downstairs room of the Penderel's Oak pub on High Holborn with 60+ attendees, and Languages in London runs free social language events on Meetup.
venue: London Language Exchange at Penderel's Oak

how: Blue Water Freediving School runs SSI and AIDA freediving courses with pool sessions in Barnet and open-water dives at Wraysbury.
Northwick Park RC Model Flying Club in Wembley flies radio-controlled model aircraft (ages 14+) under a Brent Council permit and BMFA insurance.
venue: Northwick Park RC Model Flying Club

how: London Philosophy Cafe and Philosophy Cafe London hold regular pub and cafe discussions (some free Friday sessions in Holborn), alongside Practical Philosophy Club and Philosophy in the Park groups.
Many in-person Meetup book clubs meet weekly or monthly across London, such as Islington Book Club, Drinking Club With A Reading Problem (Clapham Junction) and Croydon Bookworms.
venue: Drinking Club With A Reading Problem

how: Weekly social Texas Hold'em nights run on Meetup, including Tooting Poker Collective (Thursdays, beginners welcome) and Kingston Poker Night, plus tournament nights in Southgate.
Free Tai Chi London runs a free weekly class in Aldgate and several paid and low-cost weekly tai chi and qigong groups run across London and Surrey.
Weekly qigong classes run in London, e.g. Qi Gong Class with Andy Henry at Chalk Farm and taichi and qigong group sessions listed on Meetup.
venue: Qi Gong Class with Andy Henry

how: Weekly yoga classes run across London, including free Meditation & Yoga sessions (Swiss Cottage, Balham, Putney, Greenwich), paid classes in Twickenham and Barking, and free guided yoga in Hyde Park.
The Pilates Social runs Pilates and brunch sessions for women in London on Meetup; studio Pilates classes are widely available.
The Science Fiction Live Action Role Play (LARP) Meetup group runs games in London, such as its BPRD series.
venue: Science Fiction Live Action Role Play (LARP) Meetup

how: 104 London Debaters, The Sylvans debate group, Debait and Face to Face Debates hold regular public debate evenings in London.
French London Experience runs tutor-led conversation sessions and Babel Social, EuroClub and several other groups hold French language exchanges around London.
LLH German Conversation Club (Sprechstunde), Weekly German Chat London and Deutscher Stammtisch London hold regular German practice meetups.
The London Korean Language Meetup Group, a tutor-led Korean Study Group and a fortnightly Korean-English language exchange hold sessions in London.
BSL Cafe SW11 holds a monthly meetup, a Wednesday BSL practice session runs at the National Theatre on the Southbank for levels 1-4, and the Orpington group meets monthly.
venue: BSL practice at the National Theatre

how: Many peer support groups meet in London via Meetup, including Compassionate Bodies peer support, an OCD and intrusive thoughts group, and London Overcoming Addictions Meetup.
Kilburn Board Games' Tabletop Social and a Poolies' Night group meet to play pool at London venues; dedicated snooker clubs and pool halls also operate in the city.
Meetup lists London mentoring-related events such as monthly mentoring for systemic practitioners, mentor-led internship info sessions and mentored co-writing, mostly online.
Hen Corner at Brentford Dock runs Introduction to Making Cheese and Making New Cheeses courses, and Liberty Hall in Stamford Hill hosts a plant-based cheese making masterclass.
An Intro to Stone Carving evening short course runs in Stratford (E15) and soapstone carving workshops are listed on Eventbrite for London.
venue: Intro to Stone Carving short course (E15)

how: Massage clubs and workshops run across London, such as Massage Club at SoulMassage Studio in Highbury, Massage for Men in Whitechapel and baby massage courses.
Online courses are available from anywhere in London, and FutureLearn, a major MOOC platform, is headquartered in London.
